name: Li-Mei
source:
Specialty: Fraud
Hobby: Waterpipe
Likes: Gambling
Dislikes: Photographs

A beautiful lady who uses crude language and has a trendy fashion sense.

She's known as a gambler who shows up at the gambling dens around Asakusa, where there's no end to the gamblers who have fallen victim to her. There are rumours going around that in the past she had hit rock bottom after a massive loss, but the veracity of that claim is still unclear.

[i]"I'm Li-Mei. If you wanna play, then come over anytime—whether it's day or night, I'll play with you."[i]

[spoiler]Real name Xiao Li-en.[/spoiler]
